en.summary: The wedding of Mehmet Davutoğlu, son of Ahmet Davutoğlu, brought together numerous figures from different political parties. President Erdoğan did not attend, while Özgür Özel, Kemal Kılıçdaroğlu, and Bülent Arınç were present, with Arınç criticizing an investigation into Davutoğlu.
